title: Alter Ego
description: Alter Ego is a mod that lets you set separate profiles in Minecraft, each with its own inventory, gamemode, skin, cape, nickname, and spawn point, with Trinkets and Origins support.
body:
# Alter Ego

**Welcome to my first mod. - Fil**

**Alter Ego allows you to have separate inventories, gamemodes, advancements, skins, capes, server nicknames, set your spawn, With Profiles!** Make any item including modded ones invisible for roleplay to keep immersion, teleport to any dimension at anytime instantly with coordinates and adding lootable gravestones to the [Gravestones Mod by Pneumono](https://modrinth.com/mod/pneumono_gravestones), This mod is for **Roleplay** but you can use it simply for the skins and capes feature.

---

## Disclaimer :

This mod requires **Styled Nicknames by Patbox** for the nicknames functionality.

- Skins and Capes are done locally, so you'll need to add your own skins and capes in the `aeskins` folder. It's in your main Minecraft version/Modrinth profile folder.
- Capes must be in the correct **64x32** otherwise the mod won't accept it.
- Skins must be **64x64 or 64x32**.
- This mod supports **Trinkets** and **Origins**, so you can carry trinkets and assign different origins to each profile you make.

---

## Profiles :

More on profiles themselves: you start with a default profile, which would be your normal Minecraft Game Profile. I suggest making a new profile instead of using the default one.

All profiles are editable and can be changed at anytime in anyway. Profile Names are case sensitive, so be careful when making a new profile `[ /inv profile name ]`

You can see your current profiles and what profile you're on by using `/inv` 

More information in-game under the mods tab!
